title: Reflection-Positive Two-Dimensional Quantum Field Theories with Boundary
exact_target: Identify the generalized orthogonal symmetry and classify the specified two-dimensional boundary field theories, including possible examples beyond von Neumann algebras.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006352 (OWR-14299511-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Subfactors and Applications (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/34, pp. 1823--1886. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The fixed-point claim and field-theory classification are both retained. The classification concerns the proposed flat ultraviolet and boundary axioms above; it is not a classification of arbitrary Lorentz-invariant two-dimensional quantum field theories.
